blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats for cruising on lakes including Lake Mendota, Lake Koshkonong, Lake Monona, and Lake Waubesa. Boats accommodate groups from 8 to 32 people and include options for scenic cruises, party charters, and specialty events like football game cruises. Captains are included on some boats, and additional fuel fees apply.
